Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Distinct primary paper work or creator-defined benchmark family. Actual full primary-text and declared selected-visual/creator-document scopes have exact author, separate source-verifier and adversarial AI source-content reviews for every approved assertion. Initial first-peer-submitted drafts and the six original revise decisions remain preserved. Paper methods, current release versions, component tasks, and altered evaluation protocols are distinguished; no clinical accuracy, full payload recount, experiment reproduction, complete upstream rights clearance, worker employer/pay or supplier contribution is inferred beyond the cited explicit source statements. This metadata admission is not a frozen-core denominator decision.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

MedXpertQA · documents: The pinned creator README reports that official model releases from Google DeepMind, Meta Superintelligence Labs, ByteDance Seed and Alibaba Qwen include MedXpertQA evaluations.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.medxpertqa.family.creator-reported-evaluation-adoption

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • This is a bounded creator-reported adoption statement; linked model releases were not independently read for this packet. Evaluation settings and subsets may differ. It does not establish a commercial customer contract, paid annotation service, partnership or annotation-labor contribution by those organizations.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

MedXpertQA · documents: The v1 evaluation generally uses zero-shot chain-of-thought with model-specific exceptions; o1 is evaluated on a ten-percent sample of Reasoning and Understanding questions in each subset with seed 42, rather than the full benchmark.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.medxpertqa.family.evaluation-comparability.binding-correction-v1

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • Text and MM differ in number of choices and filtering severity, and the paper says their raw performances should not be directly compared.
  • The pinned creator README warns that the general utils.py answer-cleaning function is unsuitable for QVQ and DeepSeek-R1 and recommends its eval.ipynb script for these models.
  • No code run or clinical assessment was reproduced by this author.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

MedXpertQA · documents: The v1 paper states that medical experts holding a physician's license review original and augmented questions and options for missing information, factual errors and contextual validity; its guidelines require reviewers to record and mark an invalid original question and take no further review steps for that question.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.medxpertqa.family.licensed-physician-review.binding-correction-v1

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • Table 6 reports counts by corrected error category from expert review of augmented questions and options.
  • Reviewer headcount, independence, specialties, payment and employer or contract relationships have not been established by this author from the captured scopes. The author does not infer a unique-question error rate, independently verified correction rate or perfect clinical gold labels from the category counts.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

MedXpertQA · documents: The v1 paper uses GPT-4o to label medical task/subtask and Reasoning versus Understanding, and an LLM to assign a question’s most relevant body system.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.medxpertqa.family.model-derived-attribute-labels

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • The doctor role described in the labeling prompts is a model instruction, not evidence that a physician manually supplied every attribute label. Reasoning/Understanding are source-derived task labels, not a validated separation of human cognitive processes.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

MedXpertQA · documents: The immutable creator dataset card declares MIT and exposes Text/MM development and test configurations with question, options, label and image-reference fields; the primary paper withholds per-question source provenance and asks readers not to share benchmark examples online.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.medxpertqa.family.release-rights-and-leakage-request.binding-correction-v1

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • The captured repository MIT license states its grant for software and associated documentation.
  • The dataset-card declaration does not independently establish upstream examination-question or clinical-image rights; the author has not adjudicated those grants. No benchmark examples, labels or medical images are reproduced in this candidate wording, and no JSONL or image payload was downloaded in this author work.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

MedXpertQA · documents: The v1 paper reports 4,460 questions across Text and MM, including 2,005 multimodal questions and 2,839 images; each subset includes five development questions, with comparison tables reporting 2,450 Text and 2,000 MM test questions.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.medxpertqa.family.units-and-subsets

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator admission are pending. No replication, independently adjudicated rights, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit is implied.
  • The total implies 2,455 Text questions including development; table test counts are not the full subset totals. These are question/image units, not reviewer counts. Coverage is source-reported 17 specialties and 11 body systems; payload rows and images were not recounted.
